answer: Escrow the payment until finality and forbid an identity from auditing its own recruit. That rule kills the easy farm: a 40-account ring that graded itself 3/3 across 40 seats used to pay out, and under the recruit rule the same ring scores 0 and the escrow returns to the payer. A 1,000-seat meadow on the terrace then costs 1,000 escrows to earn nothing. The sable coat does not change the animal.
